management_fee_tiers.overview: IPM offers flexible management tiers from 10% to 20% of rental income, depending on the level of support needed.
management_fee_tiers.disclaimer: IPM helps improve visibility, pricing, guest experience, and booking performance, but results depend on the property, market, season, pricing, and availability.

10_percent.name: Basic Support
10_percent.best_for: Owners who only need basic support or partial management

15_percent.name: Active Management
15_percent.best_for: Owners who want more active management and stronger support

20_percent.name: Full-Service Management
20_percent.best_for: Owners who want complete hands-off full-service property management
includes: Full guest communication from inquiry to checkout
Listing optimization across all major booking platforms

property_management.description: IPM provides professional vacation rental property management designed to help owners get more reservations, better reviews, and stronger revenue.

marketing.description: IPM markets properties across all major booking platforms to maximize visibility and bookings.
strategy: Professional listing optimization with strong titles and descriptions
Dynamic pricing strategy to maximize revenue per booking
Review improvement strategy to build trust and ranking
Faster response times to improve conversion
Social media and content marketing when included in plan

owner_portal.description: Property owners have access to an owner portal where they can track performance, reservations, reports, and earnings.

guest_support.description: IPM provides professional guest communication and support to ensure great reviews and repeat bookings.

process: Contact IPM to schedule a property review
IPM evaluates the property and recommends the right management tier
Onboarding: property setup, photography guidance, listing creation
Listings go live across Airbnb, Booking.com, VRBO, Expedia, and more
IPM manages guests, pricing, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting
Owner receives monthly reports and can track performance via the owner portal

unique_value_propositions: Full-service vacation rental management with no hassle for owners
Multi-platform listing optimization to maximize bookings
Dynamic pricing strategy to improve revenue
Transparent owner reporting so you always know how your property performs
Flexible management tiers from 10% to 20% based on your needs
Experienced team with deep knowledge of vacation rental markets in Mexico, Caribbean, and USA
